title: Question 30
passage:
Will that dip stay cold until we get to the picnic?
A. It will if we pack it next to the ice. B. I made it with plain yogurt. C. The picnic starts at eleven.
passageZh:
我們到野餐地點之前，那份沾醬能一直保持冰涼嗎？
A. 能，只要打包時把它放在冰塊旁邊。 B. 我是用原味優格做的。 C. 野餐十一點開始。
